# Missing Error Handling for Migration Execution

Neither the offline nor online migration functions implement any error handling, so any exception during context configuration, engine creation, or migration execution will propagate uncaught and can cause the process to fail abruptly.

**Anchored to:**

- `alembic/env.py` — `alembic.env.run_migrations_offline`
- `alembic/env.py` — `alembic.env.run_migrations_online`
